mapper.sql: id, request_key as requestKey, consumable_id as consumableId, consumable_name as consumableName, unit, borrower, contact, quantity, returned_quantity as returnedQuantity, quantity - returned_quantity as remainingQuantity, purpose, date_format(due_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as dueDate, remark, operator_name as operator, date_format(borrowed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as borrowedAt, date_format(last_returned_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastReturnedAt, case when returned_quantity = quantity then '已归还' when due_date < curdate() then '已逾期' when returned_quantity > 0 then '部分归还' else '借用中' end as status
